item.title: ‘We will pay,’ Savannah Guthrie says in desperate video plea to potential kidnappers of her mother
item.description: Savannah Guthrie told the potential kidnappers of her mother Nancy Guthrie on Saturday that the family is prepared to pay for her safe return, as the frantic search for the 84-year-old Arizona resident has entered a seventh day.

item.title: Appeals court affirms Trump policy of jailing immigrants without bond
item.description: President Donald Trump's administration can continue to detain immigrants without bond, marking a major legal victory for the federal immigration agenda and countering a slew of recent lower court decisions across the country that argued the practice is illegal.

item.title: Italians collect medals on a feel-good first day for the hosts at the Milan Cortina Olympics
item.description: The 2026 Winter Games are off to a promising start for host nation Italy with gold, silver and bronze on the first day of medal events.

item.title: Trump aims to hold the first meeting of his new Board of Peace in Washington this month
item.description: President Donald Trump plans to convene the first meeting of his Board of Peace this month in Washington to raise money for the reconstruction of Gaza.
